data.exact_reserve_text: Change in net ultimate claims (5.8) for 2017 and prior YOA, and (12.8) for 2018 YOA. Gross reserve strengthening in the year arising from the cargo, energy and political risk classes, partially offset by reserve releases on the marine liability and cyber classes.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of GBP 18.6m in prior year reserves for 2019. This was driven by adverse development on the 2017 and prior years of account, specifically negative large loss experience in political risk, D&O, and energy classes, and gross reserve strengthening in 2018 for cargo, energy, and political risk classes, partially offset by releases in marine liability and cyber. These movements were partially mitigated by reinsurance protection.
raw_causal_phrases: Negative specific large loss experience arising from new losses on the political risk, D&O and energy classes
Gross reserve strengthening in the year arising from the cargo, energy and political risk classes, partially offset by reserve releases on the marine liability and cyber classes
Several specific large losses, arising from downstream energy exposures
Higher than previously reserved premium receipts, primarily arising from the cargo, hull and political risk classes
Stable experience in attritional and catastrophe reserves across all other classes of business
a number of large losses on the Energy and Political risk classes, partially mitigated by reinsurance protection

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is a net figure, as gross figure was not explicitly stated and claims development triangle was distorted by Reinsurance to Close (RITC) for the 2017 and prior years of account.
